ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in circle $\odot O$, with $BE$ being the diameter of circle $\odot O$. Connect $AE$ and $BD$. If $\angle BCD=115^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle EBD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in circle $O$, and $\angle BCD=115^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BAD=180^\circ-115^\circ=65^\circ$\\
Draw line DE, \\
Since arc $\overset{\frown}{BD}=\overset{\frown}{BD}$, \\
it follows that $\angle BED=65^\circ$\\
Since BE is the diameter of circle $O$, \\
it follows that $\angle BDE=90^\circ$\\
Therefore, $\angle EBD=90^\circ-65^\circ=\boxed{25^\circ}$
